data.name: Aadila
data.gender_notes: Aadila is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Aadila is derived from the Arabic word 'adl', meaning justice and fairness. It signifies a just and equitable person. The name Aadila carries the meaning “Just and Fair” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aadila usually hope their child will grow to embody just and fair and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islam, justice ('adl) is a fundamental attribute of Allah and a crucial virtue for believers, as mentioned in the Quran.
data.etymology: Aadila belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Just and Fair.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aadila total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: عديلة
in_arabic.meaning: العديلة تعني العادلة أو المتساوية في الحق والعدل
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم عديلة مشتق من الجذر العربي 'ع-د-ل' الذي يعني العدل والمساواة. يدل الاسم على الصفات الحميدة مثل العدل والإنصاف. في القرآن الكريم، العدل هو صفة من صفات الله تعالى. وقد استخدم هذا الاسم في الثقافة الإسلامية للإشارة إلى الشخص الذي يتصف بالعدل والحق.

in_urdu.name: عدیلہ
in_urdu.meaning: عدیلہ کا مطلب ہے انصاف کرنے والی یا برابر کرنے والی
in_urdu.long_meaning: عدیلہ نام عربی جڑ 'ع-د-ل' سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے انصاف اور مساوات۔ یہ نام انصاف اور حق کے معیار پر فخر کرتا ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی ثقافت میں، یہ نام ان لوگوں کے لیے استعمال کیا جاتا ہے جو انصاف اور مساوات کو برقرار رکھتے ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: अदीला
in_hindi.meaning: अदीला का अर्थ है न्याय करने वाली या समानता प्रदान करने वाली
in_hindi.long_meaning: अदीला नाम अरबी मूल 'ع-د-ل' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है न्याय और समानता। यह नाम न्याय और सच्चाई के मूल्यों को दर्शाता है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम उन व्यक्तियों के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है जो न्याय और समानता को महत्व देते हैं।

in_pashto.name: عدیلہ
in_pashto.meaning: عدیلہ د انصاف کوکړې یا برابرۍ کو منځه وړې
in_pashto.long_meaning: عدیلہ نوم د عربی جڑ 'ع-د-ل' څخه اخیستل شوی دی چې معنی یې انصاف او مساوات دی. دا نوم د انصاف او حق په معیارونو ویاړي. د افغان او پښتون دودیزو ټولنو کې، دا نوم د هغو کسانو لپاره کارول کیږي چې انصاف او مساوات ته ارزښت ورکوي.

in_english.name: Aadila
in_english.meaning: Aadila means one who does justice or provides equality
in_english.long_meaning: The name Aadila is derived from the Arabic root 'ع-د-ل' (aad-dal), which signifies justice and equality. In Islamic tradition, this name symbolizes fairness and righteousness. It is mentioned in various historical contexts as a desirable trait for individuals. The name Aadila is used across Muslim cultures to denote someone who upholds justice and equality.

data.cultural_impact: The name Aadila holds great cultural significance for Muslims as it resonates with the core value of justice and fairness in the Islamic tradition. A just and equitable society is highly emphasized in the Quran and Hadith, with the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) particularly advocating for fairness and justice for all, regardless of race, gender, or social status.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Aadila represents a person who embodies the divine qualities of mercy, compassion, and righteousness. By striving for justice and fairness in one's daily life, an Aadila seeks to align themselves with the divine will and act as an exemplar of God's infinite wisdom and benevolence. It is a reminder of the importance of upholding honesty and integrity, not only in our dealings with others but also in the secret chambers of our hearts. In the words of the Quran, "And let not the hatred of a people incite you not to act equitably. Be just; that is nearer to righteousness." (Chapter 5, Verse 8)

historical_references.context: Aadila bint Jaafar as-Sadiq was a renowned scholar and a member of the Prophet Muhammad's (PBUH) family. She is known for her knowledge of Hadith and Fiqh.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Aadila remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
